package lint

import (
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"
)

func TestJsxKeyUnit(t *testing.T) {
 t.Parallel()
 directory, err := filepath.Abs("."); if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
 oracle := goOracle(t)
 var rows []string
 count := 0
 for _, row := range upstream(t) {
  fields := strings.Split(row, "\t")
  if len(fields)>1 && fields[1]=="react/jsx-key" { rows=append(rows,row); count++ }
 }
 for _, d := range prepareRegistry(t,".") {
  if d.Name!="react/jsx-key" {continue}
  for _, row := range ownedWitnessRows(t,directory,d) {
   path := strings.SplitN(row,"\t",2)[0]
   rows=append(rows,row,path+"\tall")
   answer:=execute(t,"",oracle,"--manifest",manifest(t,[]string{row}),"--count")
   if string(answer.output)=="0\n" {t.Fatal("witness has no finding",path)}
  }
 }
 for _, row := range generated(t) { fields:=strings.Split(row,"\t"); if len(fields)<2 || fields[1]=="all" || fields[1]=="react/jsx-key" {rows=append(rows,row)} }
 compare(t,oracle,buildPort(t,directory,true),directory,manifest(t,recoveryRows(t,oracle,rows)))
 t.Logf("jsx-key upstream cases matched: %d; owned witnesses: 2",count)
}
